diagnostics.message: :resource.null_resource.wait_for_cluster: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_eks_cluster.this is redundant — already implied by attribute references

resource.null_resource.wait_for_cluster declares an explicit depends_on on aws_eks_cluster.this, but the same ordering is already established implicitly: the local-exec provisioner's environment block references aws_eks_cluster.this[0].endpoint, so Terraform will always create the null_resource after the cluster even without the explicit depends_on. The explicit depends_on can be removed.
